checks: UiProgress clamps values, falls back for invalid max, updates value/tone, renders one progressbar per instance, keeps 6/4 px heights, and scales the fill.
UiSpinner uses 16/24 px sizing, hides an unlabeled spinner, exposes one named status when labeled, and keeps the 9 px quarter arc, 2.5 px stroke, 800/1600 ms motion.
UiMenuItem adapts checked/disabled/keepOpen, icon and trailing slots; enabled selection closes, keepOpen and disabled selection stay open.
A tracked UList with a full-row UListItem slot moves focus once, skips disabled rows, honors defaultPrevented, activates once on Enter, keeps marked rows open, and lets Tab leave at the boundary.
Panel UiMenu yields Arrow/Home/End and Enter to UList track navigation while preserving root focus and skipping disabled rows.
Legacy UiTabPanel keeps scalar value selection, idPrefix ARIA links, and hidden panel state.
A single controlled USnackbar honors timeout -1 and forwards its role/aria-live attributes.
SnackbarHost renders all six positions, maps error to alert/assertive and other tones to status/polite, and supports manual dismissal of duration-zero notices.
Snackbar service applies a short explicit duration at runtime.
SnackbarHost uses the service 6000 ms default while the reusable USnackbar keeps its separate 5000 ms raw default.
Snackbar pointer and focus pause reasons are independent; resuming one leaves the other pause active.
Unmounting SnackbarHost clears service notices and their active timers.
